InquelloWorkspaceExecutionPolicy.description: The Workspace execution policy as the desktop main process fetched it from the shared service (`GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/execution-policy`).

execution.description: The policy's `execution` section in its canonical snake_case form, or null when the policy has none (the conservative Inquello default applies). Validated again here; an invalid section is `invalid`.

description: Runs one command for a Task inside the Task's tool profile (Story 1.19), through the runtime's own command execution. The profile is derived here from the same inputs as `inquello/policy/effective`; the Task must be the caller's and belong to the Workspace. The response is the runtime's own `command/exec` result.

command.description: Command argv vector. Empty arrays are rejected.

title: InquelloToolsExecParams
